scenario.summary: Storm-0940 used the ARTEX agentic AI framework to automate large-scale password spraying and a supply chain compromise of the ConnectWise multi-tenant application. The actor abused stolen application credentials to perform high-speed reconnaissance via Microsoft Graph, modify application credentials for persistence, and exfiltrate mailbox data from Microsoft 365 environments.

meta.rationale: Narrow focus to Microsoft 365 tenants with active ConnectWise integrations. The window of interest begins on October 10, 2026, when Storm-0940 infrastructure was first observed conducting high-volume campaigns.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary is using agentic AI to perform high-velocity reconnaissance, credential additions, and data exfiltration within our Microsoft 365 environment after compromising a trusted application.

hunt.name: ARTEX-Driven Cloud Persistence and Graph Exfiltration
hunt.description: This hunt targets the machine-speed post-authentication activity associated with Storm-0940 and the ARTEX framework. It focuses on identifying automated reconnaissance, unauthorized credential additions to OAuth applications, and high-volume data access via Microsoft Graph. The flow correlates known threat actor infrastructure with sensitive directory changes and uses stack-counting to identify anomalous API call volumes that signify automated exfiltration and persistence.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, actor_user_name, src_endpoint_ip, app_id, time FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE (instr(',' || '{{actor_ips}}' || ',', ',' || src_endpoint_ip || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{connectwise_app_ids}}' || ',', ',' || app_id || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify successful or failed sign-ins from reported actor IP addresses or using the compromised application IDs.
config.expected_signal: Rows indicate the specific account and IP used to enter the tenant; silence provides evidence of absence for these specific IOCs.

config.content: SELECT time, actor_user_name, entity_name, operation_type, attribute_name, device_hostname FROM hb_entity_management WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (LOWER(operation_type) LIKE '%credential%' OR LOWER(operation_type) LIKE '%role%' OR LOWER(operation_type) LIKE '%owner%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify entity modifications that indicate credential additions or role expansion within the tenant.
config.expected_signal: New credentials added to applications or new users added to privileged roles, potentially by automated accounts.

primitive_config.label: Directory Entity and Role Modifications
primitive_config.content: SELECT time, actor_user_name, entity_name, operation_type, attribute_name, device_hostname FROM hb_entity_management WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (LOWER(operation_type) LIKE '%credential%' OR LOWER(operation_type) LIKE '%role%' OR LOWER(operation_type) LIKE '%owner%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')

config.content: SELECT src_endpoint_ip, actor_user_name, api_operation, COUNT(*) AS call_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_cloud_api_activity WHERE provider IN ('m365', 'azure_ad') AND (LOWER(api_operation) LIKE '%mail%' OR LOWER(api_operation) LIKE '%get%' OR LOWER(api_operation) LIKE '%list%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY src_endpoint_ip, actor_user_name, api_operation HAVING call_count > 100
config.description: Stack-count sensitive API calls by source IP to identify automated data exfiltration or reconnaissance.
config.expected_signal: A single IP address or service principal performing over 100 sensitive operations in the window, suggesting AI-driven automation.

primitive_config.label: High-Velocity API Call Patterns
primitive_config.content: SELECT src_endpoint_ip, actor_user_name, api_operation, COUNT(*) AS call_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_cloud_api_activity WHERE provider IN ('m365', 'azure_ad') AND (LOWER(api_operation) LIKE '%mail%' OR LOWER(api_operation) LIKE '%get%' OR LOWER(api_operation) LIKE '%list%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY src_endpoint_ip, actor_user_name, api_operation HAVING call_count > 100
